description: Internal part of TmGantt (EditorBrowsable Never): the opt-in summary band under the tree + timeline - the rollup strip with the status donut, time spent, milestones, budget and WBS cards. A desktop container renders five cards in a row, a tablet two columns and the read-mostly mobile container a compact one-line strip (the full cards live in the mobile Summary sheet). Computed once per data refresh from the visible tasks; never place it - hosts set TmGantt.ShowSummaryBand instead.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The Gantt this band belongs to (hidden infrastructure parameter of the internal parts).

parameters.name: Sheet
parameters.description: True inside the mobile Summary sheet: the full cards render there too (never the compact strip). Internal.
